transcript.answer: Pull request #2823 in re-cinq/lore, "Context evals: run from a developer machine, never on a schedule", stopped the scheduled runs. It was opened by gedaiu and merged on 2026-10-19 as commit 241535e. It removed `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, the GitHub Actions workflow that ran the evals nightly at 03:17 UTC. After the change, `scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` is run by hand from a developer machine against the deployed lore-api. The PR also said the unattended run had gone red three nights running (10-17, 10-18 and 10-19) on a single `demo-factory-todo` document.
